The '''V'shar system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[V'shar]]. V'shar was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ka'hren]] [[Species/Legends|species]], of which there were at least 2.5 million members on the planet.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Ka'hren [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Kaltor Naklian]] had left V'shar and traveled to the<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Zuliria">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Zuliria system/Legends|Zuliria system]]</ref> world of [[Zuliria]], where he had become a founding member of the [[Zulirian Swordmasters]] group of bladed weapons aficionados.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

==Behind the scenes==
The V'shar system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square U-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
